description: Make a complete favicon set from a letter/emoji/short text or from an image: favicon.ico (16, 32, 48 px), favicon-16x16.png, favicon-32x32.png, apple-touch-icon.png (180, square, solid), android-chrome-192x192.png and -512x512.png, site.webmanifest and head-snippet.html with the <link> tags. Rounded square with background colour (or transparent), corner radius and padding in %. Writes everything into one folder. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/favicon-forge/

fit.description: How an image fills the padded square. Default contain.

image.description: Use this image (logo) instead of text: a local path or base64. Square, 512 px+ works best.

name.description: App name for site.webmanifest. Default "My Website".

output.description: Folder to write the files into. Default: a new "favicons" folder in the output folder.

padding.description: Padding around the text/image in %. Default 14.

radius.description: Corner radius in % of the size (50 = circle). Default 22.

text.description: Letter(s) or emoji drawn on the icon (when no image is given). Default "S".

transparent.description: Transparent background (the Apple icon still gets white). Default false.

name: image_favicon_set
title: Favicon set generator
